beats.text: The global median savings rate is 22.4%. Qatar sets aside 57.4% of its GDP.
Qatar has 3.5 times the USA, which stands at 16.6%.
China hits 42.7%, while Brazil sits down at 14.4%.
East Timor drops to the bottom at down 21.1%.
Gross savings are calculated as gross national income less total consumption, plus net transfers.
What share of income does your country save?
